svg.title: Intersections of an absolute quadratic with horizontal levels
svg.desc: The graph y=absolute value of x squared minus one is shown with horizontal levels a=0, one half, one, and three halves. Marked distinct intersections number two, four, three, and two respectively. The levels zero and one mark changes in the number of real solutions.
